items.stem: Which TWO practices help catch regressions before release? (Select TWO)

options.text: Gate prompt and model changes on an evaluation check
options.rationale: Correct: gating blocks changes that fail the evaluation.

options.text: Use a representative labelled dataset for the evaluation
options.rationale: Correct: representative data detects real regressions.

options.text: Ship changes with no evaluation to move faster
Evaluate only on examples the new version already passes

items.explanation: Correct: gating blocks changes that fail the evaluation.
